direct_original_source_observations.short_exact_quote: Sign ascending, or which is intercepted
direct_original_source_observations.reading: A body occupying the rising sign or an intercepted sign qualifies as primary significator; others having dignity in its place participate. This authenticates the original 1647 wording, not just later transcriptions.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: The later phrase no planet in ascendant/horoscope is not unambiguously reduced to sign-only versus quadrant-house eligibility; preserve both.

direct_original_source_observations.reading: When several planets occupy the horoscope, all signify manners; the most powerful one acts more durably. Mercury joined to several planets borrows nature from the closest conjunction and the most fortified/dignified planet.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: No universal numerical strength unit, or conjunction orb, established.

direct_original_source_observations.reading: With no planet in ascendant, inspect planets joined to Moon or Mercury, then conditionally lord of ASC and its dispositor's aspect, then a forceful partile aspect to Moon or Mercury, then most essential dignity at their places; fixed stars follow.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: Singular/multiple tie arbitration and the exact strength and orb values remain unresolved.

direct_original_source_observations.reading: Original Greek juxtaposes synapse/application and separation; Robbins says the bodies that precede (editor gloss: more occidental) apply to those that follow, if the interval is sufficiently small.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: The older sampled relative-velocity approach/recede measure and the original directional language are separate constructs; longitude polarity is a source-text proxy. The original does not stipulate numeric 1/3/5/10/15-degree orbs.

direct_original_source_observations.reading: Bodily application/separation requires participants on the same side of the ecliptic; aspect rays do not require a same-latitude-side condition.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: Same-side sign is necessary under this cited passage, not a full geometric three-dimensional conjunction quality model.

direct_original_source_observations.reading: Five ways described in III.2 for selecting lord of a given subject; when two or three compete select the one(s) with more claims. Additional magnitude/manner conditions relate to strength, angularity, course and more.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: Counting one vote per mode is a transparent bounded engineering reconstruction; it is not proof of a universal one-personality-ruler mathematical algorithm.

direct_original_source_observations.reading: Mercury and Moon have different character functions, multiple configurations and testimonies matter, especially same governors configured to Mercury and Moon.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: Source does not demand one common external governor under all cases, nor claim independent human predictive validity.

direct_original_source_observations.reading: Robbins reports anonymous commentary (Wolf, page 51) on 15 degrees and reports Ashmand alternative planet-specific orbs.
direct_original_source_observations.qualification: Neither was specified by Ptolemy; original Wolf commentary remains uncollated.

astronomy_rebind_provenance.separate_ephemeris_source_from_original_: YES, binary differs but longitude residual checked at all selectively recomputed latitude timestamps; max 1.363e-7 degrees

historically_open_questions: Original 1647 sign versus historical first-house/horoscope grammatical scope remains contested even after direct collation.
Lilly's planetary fortification, dispositor and essential dignity arbitration have not become source-unique executable numbers.
Original Ptolemy five-way fifth phase/aspect ruler-selection requires source-specific proximity and stronger/contrary testimony; 1/3/5/10/15 degrees remain experimental.
Robbins-cited anonymous Wolf commentary has not been independently collated from original Greek.
Printed Ptolemy versus Egyptian terms, original co-rulers, and many other testimony variants remain source-conditioned, not pooled.
No human natal interpretation, personal profile score, or complete unbiased century-wide personality ranking has been computed in this pass.
